root_cause: Both LLM accuracy jobs (CPU and iGPU) fail at pytest collection time before any test runs: importing the pip-installed openvino_genai wheel triggers import of its compiled py_openvino_genai extension, which dynamically links against libopenvino.so.2640 (the OpenVINO runtime shared object versioned by build number 2640). That shared object is absent from LD_LIBRARY_PATH/site-packages in this job's environment, so the dynamic loader fails before any LLM/whowhatbench code executes. This is identical in every respect (message, stack, both jobs) to the previously recorded pattern a87e95431b0e8175, now at its 7th occurrence over the last ~2 days across unrelated PRs (build/tooling, layer tests, NPU dependency bumps). The PR under test here (#38337) only touches src/plugins/intel_npu/cmake/download_compiler_libs.cmake (NPU compiler prebuilt-lib version bump) and has no relationship to the openvino_genai/libopenvino packaging path, confirming this is a pre-existing environment/packaging defect (likely a mismatched or missing libopenvino runtime library version pinned in the LLM accuracy test venv/wheel, unrelated to the merged PR) rather than a regression introduced by this PR.
reproduction_steps: Not reproducible from a local source checkout alone. In CI: use the same LLM-accuracy job image, pip install the pinned openvino_genai wheel, then run `python3 -m pytest tests/llm/accuracy_conformance.py --collect-only` and observe the ImportError for libopenvino.so.2640. Locally, this typically means the OpenVINO C++ runtime .so installed alongside is a different/older build than the one openvino_genai's binding was built against — check that the LLM accuracy job's install/build step actually produces and exposes libopenvino.so.2640 on LD_LIBRARY_PATH before pip-installing openvino_genai.
recommended_actions: Fix the LLM accuracy CPU/iGPU test job setup so the runtime OpenVINO shared libraries (build 2640) are built/installed and exported on LD_LIBRARY_PATH/RPATH before the openvino_genai wheel is imported (job_llm_accuracy_tests.yml).
Verify version alignment between the openvino_genai wheel being installed and the OpenVINO runtime package produced by the same CI run; pin or rebuild consistently.

Given this is the 7th occurrence in ~2 days affecting merge-queue merges of unrelated PRs, escalate to the CI/build-infra owners as a blocking infrastructure defect rather than continuing to investigate per-PR.
prevention_strategies: Add a smoke check step right after installing openvino_genai in the LLM accuracy jobs that runs `python3 -c "import openvino_genai"` and fails fast with a clear diagnostic (missing library path) instead of surfacing as an opaque pytest collection error; add a CI health check that verifies the runtime .so version matches the wheel's expected version before running the full test suite.
historical_context: Identical normalized signature previously recorded 6 times between 2026-09-21T15:45:59Z and 2026-09-22T18:05:30Z (runs 35611485728, 35717727822, 35719650364, 35742977292, 35751991888, 35755893592; PRs #38190, #38329, #38200, #38341), all unrelated to NPU/compiler changes, confirming a persistent shared packaging/environment defect in the LLM accuracy job rather than a per-PR regression.
